user.title: Family Tracking
user.description:
This integration provides the sensors, resolves the addresses and stores the positions for the card's timeline. Which people a card shows is set on the dashboard.

**Position history:** stored since {store_since}, currently {store_size}. The positions live in a file of their own (`family_tracking.db`) in the config folder, apart from Home Assistant's database, whose retention for every other device stays as it is.

data_description.persons: Each of these people gets two sensors: location and distance from home. Everyone is ticked to begin with; as long as everyone stays ticked, anybody added later gets their sensors too. The card's own selection is independent — leaving somebody out here does not remove them from the card, it only takes away their sensors.
data_description.keep: Pick from the list or type your own: a number and d (days), m (months) or y (years), e.g. “40 d”, “18 m” or “3 y”. Written out works too. Older positions are deleted every night; a shorter period deletes what lies beyond it as soon as it is saved. On its first start the integration takes over what Home Assistant still holds – older days cannot be brought back.
data_description.geocode: Master switch for the whole instance, the card included. Off means not a single request to Nominatim. Stays then carry zone names, or coordinates.
data_description.geocode_email: Sent along as the `email` parameter. Nominatim's usage policy asks for it so they can reach you about a problem instead of blocking you.
data_description.max_accuracy: The smaller the value, the stricter: only accurate fixes count, but more are left out – indoors, for instance – and the track gets gaps. The larger, the more inaccurate points get through. Applies to the live position, the sensors and the card's timeline. Crossing into a zone always counts. Every fix is stored; a higher value brings hidden points back.
data_description.home_zone: The reference point for the distance sensor and for what counts as home.

abort.already_configured: Family Tracking is already set up.

error.keep_too_long: That is too long – at most 20 years (20 y, 240 m or 7300 d).
error.keep_no_number: The number at the start is missing. Please type a whole number from 1 followed by d, m or y, e.g. “40 d”.
error.keep_whole_number: “{typed}” is not a whole number. Please leave out the decimals, e.g. “18 m” instead of “1.5 y”.
error.keep_unknown_unit: “{typed}” is not a unit. Use d (days), m (months) or y (years), e.g. “40 d”, “18 m” or “3 y”.
